text: 震惊！每天早上喝一杯水的人，后来都怎样了？
textEn: Shocking! What happened to people who drink water every morning?
why: 「震惊」加问句，只吊胃口不给结论。
whyEn: It opens with 'shocking' and a question but never gives the answer.

text: 99%的人都洗错了！碗筷原来要这样洗
textEn: 99% of people wash dishes wrong! Here's the right way
why: 「99%的人」是夸张套路，制造焦虑。
whyEn: '99% of people' is a stock exaggeration meant to create anxiety.

text: 刚刚，一条消息让全体上班族沉默了
textEn: Just now, one message left every office worker speechless
why: 「刚刚」「沉默了」，却不说是什么消息。
whyEn: 'Just now' and 'speechless', but it never says what the message was.

text: 千万别再这样吃鸡蛋了，很多人已经中招
textEn: Stop eating eggs this way! Many people have already fallen for it
why: 「千万别」吓人，又不说是哪种吃法。
whyEn: It scares you with 'stop' but hides which way of eating it means.

text: 看完这篇文章，我连夜删了手机里这个软件
textEn: After reading this, I deleted this app from my phone that night
why: 「这个软件」藏起关键信息，逼你点开。
whyEn: 'This app' hides the key fact so you have to click.

text: 不转不是中国人！这段视频看哭了千万网友
textEn: Share or you're not Chinese! This video made millions cry
why: 道德绑架逼转发，还夸大情绪。
whyEn: It guilt-trips you into sharing and inflates the emotion.

text: 一个小区保安的举动，让整栋楼的人都惊呆了
textEn: One security guard's act stunned the whole building
why: 「惊呆了」却不说保安做了什么。
whyEn: 'Stunned', yet it never says what the guard did.

text: 医生不会告诉你：这种水果千万别空腹吃
textEn: What doctors won't tell you: never eat this fruit on an empty stomach
why: 假装揭秘，又不说是哪种水果。
whyEn: It pretends to reveal a secret but hides which fruit.

text: 他用三年时间做了一件事，结果令人泪目……
textEn: He spent three years on one thing, and the result will move you to tears...
why: 「一件事」加省略号，什么都没交代。
whyEn: 'One thing' plus an ellipsis explains nothing.

text: 紧急提醒！家里有这种插座的赶快拔掉
textEn: Urgent! If you have this kind of socket at home, unplug it now
why: 「紧急」制造恐慌，却不说是哪种插座。
whyEn: 'Urgent' stirs panic without saying which socket.

text: 惊呆了！小学生的一篇作文让老师当场落泪
textEn: Stunned! A pupil's essay made the teacher cry on the spot
why: 只写情绪，不写作文内容。
whyEn: It only reports emotions, not what the essay said.

text: 刚刚曝光！你每天用的这个东西竟比马桶还脏
textEn: Just exposed! Something you use daily is dirtier than a toilet
why: 「这个东西」藏起主角，用恶心吓人。
whyEn: 'Something' hides the subject and uses disgust to scare you.

text: 微信这个功能太可怕了，赶紧关掉！
textEn: This WeChat feature is terrifying. Turn it off now!
why: 「太可怕」却不说是哪个功能。
whyEn: 'Terrifying', but it never names the feature.

text: 速看！明天起，这些东西将全面涨价
textEn: Read now! From tomorrow, these things all go up in price
why: 「这些东西」不点名，用紧迫感骗点击。
whyEn: 'These things' are never named; urgency drives the click.

text: 他放弃百万年薪回老家，结果让所有人意想不到
textEn: He quit a million-yuan job to go home, and no one saw what came next
why: 「意想不到」吊胃口，结果藏在正文里。
whyEn: 'No one saw it coming' teases; the outcome is hidden.

text: 吃了二十年的米饭，原来一直吃错了
textEn: Twenty years of eating rice, and you've been doing it wrong
why: 用「一直错了」制造焦虑，不说错在哪。
whyEn: It creates anxiety with 'doing it wrong' but never says how.

text: 这才是真正的高手，看到最后我跪了
textEn: This is a true master. By the end I was on my knees
why: 只说情绪，不说高手是谁、做了什么。
whyEn: Only emotion: no who and no what.

text: 史上最全！不收藏你一定会后悔
textEn: The most complete ever! You'll regret not saving this
why: 「史上最全」「一定会后悔」，空洞夸张。
whyEn: 'Most complete ever' and 'you'll regret it' are empty hype.

text: 女子每天吃一个苹果，一年后体检结果吓坏医生
textEn: Woman ate an apple a day; a year later her checkup scared the doctor
why: 「吓坏医生」夸张，结果却不说。
whyEn: 'Scared the doctor' exaggerates and hides the result.

text: 赶快删除！这几张图片手机里有的要注意了
textEn: Delete them now! If these photos are on your phone, watch out
why: 恐吓加隐瞒，不说是什么图片。
whyEn: It frightens you and hides which photos it means.

text: 年轻人注意！熬夜的后果比你想象的可怕一百倍
textEn: Young people beware! Staying up late is 100 times worse than you think
why: 「可怕一百倍」是夸张恐吓，没有数据。
whyEn: '100 times worse' is a scare with no data.

text: 这条街火了！每天排队上千人，原因竟是……
textEn: This street went viral! Thousands queue daily, and the reason is...
why: 「竟是」加省略号，原因藏起来。
whyEn: 'The reason is...' with an ellipsis hides the answer.

text: 一只流浪猫天天守在门口，真相让人鼻子一酸
textEn: A stray cat waits at the door every day. The truth will choke you up
why: 「真相」却不说真相，只煽情。
whyEn: It promises 'the truth' but only tugs at feelings.

text: 惊！这种常见零食被列为致癌物，很多孩子在吃
textEn: Shock! A common snack is listed as a carcinogen, and kids eat it
why: 恐吓家长又不点名零食。
whyEn: It scares parents without naming the snack.

text: 天天玩电脑的人，后来都怎么样了？
textEn: What became of people who use computers every day?
why: 问句吊胃口，暗示有可怕结果却不说。
whyEn: A teasing question hints at doom but says nothing.

text: 你还在这样关电脑吗？难怪电脑越来越卡
textEn: Still shutting down your PC this way? No wonder it's getting slow
why: 「这样」不说是哪样，制造焦虑。
whyEn: 'This way' is never explained; it just creates worry.

text: 太扎心了！看完这十张图，80后全沉默了
textEn: So painful! After these ten pictures, everyone born in the 80s went silent
why: 「扎心」「沉默了」，全是情绪没有信息。
whyEn: 'Painful' and 'silent' are all emotion and no information.

text: 网吧老板不会告诉你：这几台机器千万别坐
textEn: What cafe owners won't tell you: never sit at these machines
why: 假装揭秘加「千万别」，却不说是哪几台、为什么。
whyEn: A fake secret plus 'never', without saying which machines or why.

text: iPhone 7一发布，所有人都在疯抢这个配件！
textEn: iPhone 7 is out and everyone is rushing to buy this accessory!
why: 事件真实，但「所有人疯抢」夸张，又藏起配件名。
whyEn: The launch is real, but 'everyone' is hype and the accessory is hidden.

text: 欧洲杯最大黑马竟是它！结果让人热泪盈眶
textEn: The Euro's biggest dark horse is... them! The result will make you cry
why: 「竟是它」藏起球队名字，只给情绪。
whyEn: 'Is... them!' hides the team and just offers emotion.

text: 刚刚！中国女排夺冠，看完这段话的人都哭了
textEn: Just now! China's women's volleyball won, and everyone who read this cried
why: 夺冠是真的，但「看完都哭了」是标题党包装。
whyEn: The win is real, but 'everyone cried' is a clickbait wrapper.

text: 天宫二号升空，背后这个细节99%的人没注意
textEn: Tiangong-2 launched, and 99% missed this detail
why: 发射是真的，「99%的人没注意」是套路。
whyEn: The launch is real; '99% missed this' is a stock hook.

text: 关于里约奥运，这件事千万别不知道！
textEn: About the Rio Olympics: you absolutely must know this!
why: 奥运是真的，但「这件事」什么都没说。
whyEn: The Olympics are real, but 'this' tells you nothing.

text: 《Pokémon GO》火了，但玩之前千万要看这篇
textEn: Pokémon GO is a hit, but read this before you play!
why: 游戏走红是真的，「千万要看」是吓人吊胃口。
whyEn: The game's success is real; 'must read' is a scare hook.

text: 欧洲杯开幕了！不看这篇你就OUT了
textEn: Euro 2016 has kicked off! Skip this and you're out of the loop
why: 开幕是真的，「不看就OUT」是逼点击。
whyEn: The opening is real; 'skip this and you're out' pushes clicks.

text: 市图书馆国庆期间开放时间调整为9:00至17:00
textEn: City library hours over National Day: 9:00 to 17:00
why: 时间、地点、内容都在标题里。
whyEn: Time, place and content are all in the headline.

text: 本周五全市中小学开展消防疏散演练
textEn: City schools hold a fire evacuation drill this Friday
why: 谁、什么时候、做什么，一句说清。
whyEn: Who, when and what, stated in one line.

text: 气象台发布高温黄色预警，明天最高气温37℃
textEn: Yellow heat alert issued; tomorrow's high will reach 37°C
why: 预警等级和温度都直接写出。
whyEn: The alert level and temperature are given directly.

text: 市场监管局抽检：3批次桶装水菌落总数超标
textEn: Inspectors find bacteria above limits in 3 batches of bottled water
why: 有部门、数量和问题，平实陈述。
whyEn: It names the agency, the number and the problem plainly.

text: 自来水公司：周三凌晨城东片区降压供水
textEn: Water company: lower pressure in the east district early Wednesday
why: 通知写清时间和范围。
whyEn: The notice states the time and area.

text: 研究显示：睡眠不足6小时会影响次日注意力
textEn: Study: under six hours of sleep affects next-day attention
why: 有具体数字和结论，没有吓人用语。
whyEn: It gives a number and a finding without scare words.

text: 市一中新校区9月投入使用，可容纳2400名学生
textEn: No. 1 Middle School's new campus opens in September for 2,400 students
why: 时间、地点、规模都写清楚了。
whyEn: Time, place and size are all stated.

text: 市体育中心本周末举办免费羽毛球公开赛
textEn: Sports centre hosts a free badminton open this weekend
why: 直接说活动内容。
whyEn: It states the event directly.

text: 文化部门检查网吧：未成年人一律不得入内
textEn: Culture officials inspect internet cafes: no minors allowed
why: 把检查内容直接写在标题里。
whyEn: The inspection rule is right in the headline.

text: 防汛提醒：暴雨天千万别在地下通道停留
textEn: Flood alert: never linger in underpasses during heavy rain
why: 虽有「千万别」，但要求说得清清楚楚。
whyEn: It says 'never', but the instruction itself is fully stated.

text: 研究：长期熬夜会增加心血管疾病风险
textEn: Study: long-term late nights raise cardiovascular risk
why: 话题吓人，但措辞平实、结论直说。
whyEn: The topic is scary, but the wording is plain and the finding stated.

text: 公安提醒：陌生人发来的「中奖链接」千万别点
textEn: Police: never click 'prize-winning links' from strangers
why: 有「千万别」，但把危险和做法都讲明了。
whyEn: It says 'never', but both the risk and the advice are clear.

text: 火车站今起增开临时列车，缓解暑期客流
textEn: Station adds extra trains from today for summer travel
why: 时间、做法、原因都交代了。
whyEn: It covers when, what and why.

text: 市人民医院开通网上预约挂号，可提前7天预约
textEn: City hospital opens online booking up to 7 days ahead
why: 直接说新服务和规则。
whyEn: It states the new service and its rule.

text: 小区物业通知：周六上午9点清洗二次供水水箱
textEn: Property notice: water tanks cleaned Saturday at 9 a.m.
why: 普通通知，时间和事项都写明。
whyEn: A plain notice with the time and task stated.

text: 市科技馆暑期推出机器人编程体验课
textEn: Science museum launches summer robot coding classes
why: 谁推出了什么，一目了然。
whyEn: Who launched what is clear at a glance.

text: 苹果发布4英寸iPhone SE，国行3288元起
textEn: Apple unveils the 4-inch iPhone SE from 3,288 yuan in China
why: 产品、尺寸、价格都写清楚了。
whyEn: Product, size and price are all given.

text: 华为在伦敦发布P9，搭载徕卡双摄像头
textEn: Huawei launches the P9 in London with Leica dual cameras
why: 谁、在哪、发布了什么，平实陈述。
whyEn: Who, where and what, stated plainly.

text: 苹果WWDC宣布OS X更名为macOS
textEn: Apple announces at WWDC that OS X is renamed macOS
why: 直接说事件结果。
whyEn: It states the outcome directly.

text: 里约奥运会圣火在希腊奥林匹亚点燃
textEn: The Rio Olympic flame is lit in Olympia, Greece
why: 直接说事件和地点。
whyEn: It states the event and place directly.

text: 神威·太湖之光登顶全球超级计算机500强
textEn: Sunway TaihuLight tops the global TOP500 supercomputer list
why: 消息很振奋，但只是平实陈述结果。
whyEn: Exciting news, but the headline simply states the result.

text: 长征七号运载火箭在海南文昌首飞成功
textEn: Long March 7 rocket succeeds on maiden flight from Wenchang, Hainan
why: 直接说发射结果。
whyEn: It states the launch result directly.

text: 《疯狂动物城》3月4日在内地上映
textEn: Zootopia opens in mainland cinemas on March 4
why: 片名和上映日期，一句说清。
whyEn: Title and release date in one line.

text: 电影《魔兽》6月8日在内地上映
textEn: The film Warcraft opens in mainland China on June 8
why: 平实的上映信息。
whyEn: Plain release information.

text: 猴年春晚2月7日晚8点直播
textEn: Year of the Monkey Spring Festival Gala airs Feb 7 at 8 p.m.
why: 节目和时间都在标题里。
whyEn: The show and time are in the headline.

text: 欧洲杯6月10日在法国开幕，24支球队参赛
textEn: Euro 2016 opens in France on June 10 with 24 teams
why: 时间、地点、规模都写清楚了。
whyEn: Date, place and size are all given.

text: 葡萄牙加时1:0胜法国，夺得欧洲杯冠军
textEn: Portugal beat France 1-0 in extra time to win Euro 2016
why: 比分和结果直接写出。
whyEn: The score and result are stated directly.

text: 第31届夏季奥运会在里约热内卢开幕
textEn: The 31st Summer Olympics open in Rio de Janeiro
why: 直接说事件。
whyEn: It states the event directly.

text: 《Pokémon GO》在美国、澳大利亚等地上线
textEn: Pokémon GO launches in the US, Australia and other regions
why: 游戏名和上线地区都写明。
whyEn: It names the game and the launch regions.

text: 苹果发布iPhone 7，首次支持IP67级防水
textEn: Apple unveils iPhone 7, its first with IP67 water resistance
why: 产品和新功能都写在标题里。
whyEn: The product and the new feature are in the headline.

text: 网易手游《阴阳师》9月2日在iOS平台公测
textEn: NetEase's mobile game Onmyoji launches its iOS open beta on Sept 2
why: 游戏、公司、日期一应俱全。
whyEn: Game, company and date are all given.

text: 天宫二号与神舟十一号完成自动交会对接
textEn: Tiangong-2 and Shenzhou-11 complete automatic docking
why: 直接说任务结果。
whyEn: It states the mission result directly.

text: 微软发布Xbox One S，支持4K视频播放
textEn: Microsoft unveils Xbox One S with 4K video playback
why: 产品和卖点一句说清。
whyEn: Product and key feature in one line.

text: 三星宣布永久停产Galaxy Note7
textEn: Samsung permanently halts Galaxy Note7 production
why: 事件很戏剧，但标题只是平实陈述。
whyEn: A dramatic story, but the headline is a plain statement.

text: 新海诚动画电影《你的名字。》在日本上映
textEn: Makoto Shinkai's anime film Your Name opens in Japan
why: 导演、片名、事件都写清楚了。
whyEn: Director, title and event are all stated.
